decision_conditions: The proposed single storey rear extension would, by reason of the cumulative depth and siting be an intrusive, overbearing and unneighbourly development as well as having an adverse effect on the amenities of adjoining occupiers with Nos. 76 and 80 Northdown Road contrary to Policies 7 and 24 of the Havering Local Plan and Havering's Residential Extensions and Alterations SPD.

Statement Required by Article 35 (2) of the Town and Country Planning (Development Management Procedure) (England) Order 2015: Consideration was given to seeking amendments, but given conflict with adopted planning policy and absence of any pre-application advice being sought, a decision was taken to proceed to determination as submitted, enabling the applicant to exercise the right to appeal if so desired.
